name: calivix-mobile
description: Calivix para iPhone, iPad e Android (Capacitor)

scripts.add:ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && node patch-native.mjs
scripts.add:android: npm run web && npx cap add android && node patch-native.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync && node patch-native.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
